title: Accessibility and Comfort Toggles
description:
Purpose: Settings for vignette intensity, turn type/speed, flight assist strength, haptic intensity, subtitle size, colorblind mode, snap-turn angle, seated height calibration, motion cue opacity. Reachable via Wrist Menu (X) and persists.

Controls/UI:
- Sliders/toggles on Wrist Menu > Settings > Accessibility & Comfort.

Params (params_json): defaults for each toggle.

Behaviour:
- Writes to CAccessibilitySettings and CComfortState; notifies dependent systems (locomotion_options_ui, haptics_manager, hud_and_wrist_menu) to apply immediately; persists via save_persistence.

Acceptance hooks:
- test_accessibility_toggles applies and persists.

Integration and depends_on:
- Depends on hud_and_wrist_menu (page registration) and save_persistence (storage).

Suggested file split: accessibility_register.cpp, accessibility_runtime.cpp.
